title: Finite etale descent to a finitely presented algebra stage
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $B$ any commutative A-algebra, $f:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and $U\to Y_B=Y\times_A\operatorname{Spec}B$ finite etale [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. There exist a finitely presented A-algebra R, an A-algebra map $c:R\to B$, a finite etale cover $W\to Y_R=Y\times_A\operatorname{Spec}R$, and $l:Y_B\to Y_R$ whose Y projection is canonical and whose R projection is the B projection followed by Spec(c), with an isomorphism $W\times_{Y_R,l}Y_B\cong U$ over $Y_B$.

proof.text: Construct the directed nonempty poset I of finitely generated A-subalgebras of B, using Subalgebra.fgAdjoinSingleton and the directed-order instance. Define the ring diagram and its inclusion cocone. Prove its colimit universal property explicitly with Subalgebra.iSupLift after restricting scalars to integers [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Spec preserves the opposite limit, so Spec B is the limit of the spectra [lem-weil-pbc-spec-colimit-limit]. Define E_i = Y ×_A Spec R_i and its cone with vertex Y_B, using pullback.map. The commuting structure maps and cartesian projection squares make the cone limiting by Mathlib isLimitOfIsPullbackOfIsConnected, realizing base change of limits [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-over-limit]. Its transitions are affine base changes, and its stages are proper over affine schemes [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change, def-weil-proper-morphism], hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. The final finitely generated subalgebra is finitely presented over Noetherian A by Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType.

proof.text: For the qcqs inverse system E, finite and etale U.hom is of finite presentation [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Apply Scheme.exists_isPullback_of_finitePresentation from the source AffineTransitionLimit module [thm-pd-spreading-out, part (1)], obtaining a finite-presentation morphism p:W→E_i and a cartesian square. Its source is qcqs. Regard p as the morphism Over.mk p → Over.mk (id E_i). A private proved helper identifies its Over.pullback morphism with pullback.snd p q up to the invertible projection pullback.snd (id E_i) q. Transfer finiteness and etaleness from U through the cartesian-square isomorphism. Apply exists_isFinite_baseChange_stage [lem-weil-pbc-descend-finite] and Etale.exists_stage_of_inverseLimit [lem-weil-pbc-descend-etale] to this arrow over the system E. Directedness gives one upper stage r for both; a second proved helper preserves each property using isPullback_pullback_map and stability under base change [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. Construct U→W_r by pullback.lift and use cartesian-square cancellation (IsPullback.of_right) to preserve the square over Y_B.

After increasing i we may assume that U_i -> X_{A_i} is finite and etale (Limits, Lemmas 01ZO and 07RP)' (lines 1824-1829)

proof.text: Take R to be the finitely generated subalgebra at r and c its inclusion into B. Bundle the finite etale morphism W_r→Y_R as a MorphismProperty.Over object. Take l to be the cone projection Y_B→Y_R. The two required equations follow from pullback.map and the definition of the Spec cone [def-pc-fibre-product]. The inverse of the cartesian-square isomorphism, with isoPullback_inv_snd, gives Over.isoMk: Over.mk (pullback.snd W.hom l) ≅ Over.mk U.hom. No nontrivial-ring or nonempty-cover assumption is used.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finiteEtale_algebra_stage {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsProper f] (U : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤ (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))))) : ∃ (R : Type u) (_ : CommRing R) (_ : Algebra A R), Algebra.FinitePresentation A R ∧ ∃ (c : R →ₐ[A] B) (W : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤ (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A R))))) (l : pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))) ⟶ pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A R)))), l ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = pullback.fst _ _ ∧ l ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = pullback.snd _ _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom c.toRingHom) ∧ Nonempty (Over.mk (pullback.snd W.hom l) ≅ Over.mk U.hom)
